project_scope.selection_mode: B039 canonical anchors + B152 strict-review handoff
project_scope.note: All three current Monarda source concepts are installed learner cards. M. citriodora and M. punctata are project-range PASS; M. fistulosa is canonical learner-approved with range UNRESOLVED and remains excluded from confirmed-native metrics.

priority: calyx teeth and calyx-mouth hair pattern
annual versus perennial habit as supporting context
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify these Monarda from flower color alone. Start with stacked whorls versus a dense rounded terminal head, then bract and calyx structure. M. fistulosa range remains unresolved independently of learner admission.

quick_key.if: strongly interrupted/tiered whorls; purplish bracts and calyx teeth drawn into conspicuous long bristle tips
tiered whorls with pale bracts; cream/yellow corollas heavily purple-spotted; pointed non-bristled bracts; open ciliate calyx mouth
dense rounded terminal head rather than conspicuous stacked whorls; perennial habit; calyx throat densely hairy
quick_key.then: Monarda fistulosa — canonical learner card; range UNRESOLVED

look_here_first: 1. Decide stacked separated whorls versus dense rounded terminal head.
3. Inspect calyx teeth and the calyx-mouth hair pattern.
4. Use corolla spotting and life history only as confirmation.
